faq.question: What documents are required to rent a car?
faq.answer: To rent a vehicle, you typically need a valid driving license, a government-issued photo ID (such as a passport or Aadhaar card), and a valid payment method. Some premium vehicles may require additional verification or a refundable security deposit before the booking is confirmed.

faq.question: What is the minimum age requirement to rent a car?
faq.answer: he minimum age to rent a car is generally 21 years, although this may vary depending on the vehicle category. Certain luxury or premium vehicles may require drivers to be at least 25 years old with a valid driving history.

faq.question: Can I book a car online?
faq.answer: Yes. CarVerse offers a simple and secure online booking system. You can browse available vehicles, select your preferred rental dates, choose pickup and drop-off locations, and receive instant booking confirmation after completing the reservation process.

faq.question: Are your vehicles insured?
faq.answer: Yes. Every vehicle in our fleet is covered by comprehensive insurance to provide additional peace of mind during your rental period. Coverage details and customer responsibilities are clearly explained at the time of booking and in the rental agreement.

faq.question: Can I cancel or modify my booking?
faq.answer: Absolutely. You can modify or cancel your reservation according to our cancellation policy. Depending on how close your request is to the pickup date, cancellation charges may apply. Please contact our support team for assistance with any changes.

faq.question: Is there a mileage limit on rental cars?
faq.answer: Mileage limits depend on the rental package you choose. Some plans include unlimited mileage, while others have daily or total distance limits. Any additional mileage beyond the included limit will be charged according to the rental agreement.

faq.question: Do you provide airport pickup and drop-off services?
faq.answer: Yes. We offer convenient airport pickup and drop-off services to make your travel easier. Simply provide your flight details during booking, and we'll ensure your vehicle is ready when you arrive or depart.

faq.question: What should I do if the car breaks down during my trip?
faq.answer: If you experience any mechanical issues or a breakdown, contact our 24/7 customer support immediately. Our roadside assistance team will arrange prompt help, including repairs, towing, or a replacement vehicle whenever necessary.

faq.question: Can someone else drive the rented vehicle?
faq.answer: Yes, additional drivers may be permitted if they are registered during the booking process and meet our eligibility requirements. Each additional driver must provide a valid driving license and any required identification before approval.

faq.question: How do I make a payment for my booking?
faq.answer: We accept multiple secure payment methods, including credit cards, debit cards, online banking, and popular digital payment options. Payment details are encrypted to ensure a safe, reliable, and hassle-free booking experience for every customer.
